spots.text: Coral is patient. It had all the time in the world, and so, it turns out, do you.

meta.label: The Coral Archive
meta.blurb: The sea came in and went out again and took nothing, only left the shelves a little more alive than they were. Mind the corals; they are reading.

secrets.name: Inside the Great Coral
secrets.text: You found the way in behind the white fans. Inside the coral it is blue and hushed, like the bottom of a very old sea, and somebody has been reading down here.
